title: if and else inside a loop
idea: Each pass can take one of two actions using if/else inside the loop. Every pass does SOMETHING, but which depends on the value. Review else.

exercises.prompt: With if/else inside a loop, on each pass...
options: Exactly one of the two branches runs
exercises.explanation: if/else means one or the other. Every pass picks a branch based on the condition — never both.
i = 1 odd, 2 even, 3 odd, 4 even. Each pass labels the number, choosing a branch by the test.

exercises.prompt: With if/else in a loop, every pass prints something (unlike a bare if, which may print nothing on some passes).
exercises.explanation: Yes. A bare if can skip a pass; if/else always does one branch, so every pass acts.
i = 1 and 2 are not > 2 (small); i = 3 is (big). So small, small, big.

exercises.prompt: The else must be lined up with which keyword?
options: The if it belongs to (same indentation)
exercises.explanation: else pairs with its if and sits at the same indentation. Both are one level in, inside the loop body.

exercises.prompt: Arrange a loop that prints 'yes' when i is even and 'no' otherwise (i from 1 to 3).
exercises.explanation: for, if (level 1), 'yes' (level 2), else (level 1), 'no' (level 2). Output: no, yes, no.

options: 5 — one per pass, always a branch
exercises.explanation: if/else guarantees one print per pass, so 5 passes give 5 lines.

options: It prints the odds (1, 3, 5) then the count of evens (2)
exercises.explanation: Odd passes print i (1, 3, 5); even passes count (2, 4 -> count 2). After the loop, count is 2.

exercises.prompt: A learner indented else under the print instead of lining it up with if. What happens?
options: An error — else must align with its if
exercises.explanation: Misaligned else is a syntax error. It must sit at the same indentation as the if it belongs to.

exercises.prompt: Re-check: label each of 1 to 3 as 'low' if under 2, else 'high'. What prints?
exercises.explanation: i = 1 is under 2 (low); 2 and 3 are not (high). So low, high, high. if/else gives every pass a label.
